stage_1_observation_value.primary_baseline: Source-trained GRU with chronological new observations, original frozen c12 decoder
controls: Source-only affine or small adapter from m4 to teacher e12, no new observations
Same-dimensional GRU trained from scratch with no new-observation input but identical step count/source examples
Prefix c4-native decoder trained only on source, as a diagnostic of c12-decoder compatibility versus information availability
Time-shuffled and cross-tile new inputs as secondary perturbations; OOD failure alone is not evidence of causal reliance
stage_1_observation_value.decision: If a no-new-input control matches the observed updater, narrow claim to representation-contract correction; if real observations improve it, proceed to event/quality-aware update
stage_1_observation_value.warning: Do not compare cross-tile OOD corruption with clean inputs and call the entire gap useful temporal evidence

stage_2_task_fidelity.first_comparison: Same successful GRU: normalized feature MSE versus feature MSE plus frozen source-task readout KL
